text: Risk management is a vital process for any successful project or business. It begins with identifying potential risks, which are uncertain events that could have a negative impact. These can range from financial issues to supply chain problems. Once identified, the next step is to develop mitigation strategies. This means taking proactive actions to reduce the likelihood of the risk occurring or to lessen its potential impact. However, even with good mitigation, some risks will still happen. Therefore, it is essential to create contingency plans. These are backup actions triggered if a risk materialises, ensuring you can respond quickly and effectively. Finally, risk management is not a one-time task; it requires constant monitoring and review to adapt to changing circumstances.
